description: Per-family ANE op legality matrix. Each entry documents whether a MIL op can land on the ANE for a given AneFamily, and what constraints apply.

ane_landing_ops.empirical_note: PEFUSEDElementwiseUnary converter exists for neg in ANEC, but cpu_only_ops.rs marks neg as CPU-only. The theoretical converter is not invoked by the placement pass; the op always falls back to CPU. Likely excluded because neg has no dedicated ANE hardware path despite sharing the generic unary dialect.

ane_landing_ops.architecture_conditional_note: ConvertSoftmax is family-agnostic (no MinimumFamily in binary) but ANEC has architecture-conditional rejection strings. Older variants (A11Legacy/A12/A13) may reject at compile time. T-105 adds soft-warning at placement for these families.

ane_landing_ops.empirical_note: PEFUSEDSelect converter exists in ANEC for where, but cpu_only_ops.rs marks where as CPU-only with NoANECConverter reason. The converter exists in the binary but is never invoked during placement; the op always falls back to CPU. The select/where ANE path may be reserved for internal fusion patterns only.

PEFUSEDSelect converter exists in ANEC for select, but cpu_only_ops.rs marks select as CPU-only with NoANECConverter reason. The converter exists in the binary but is never invoked during placement; the op always falls back to CPU. The select/where ANE path may be reserved for internal fusion patterns only.

ane_landing_ops.architecture_conditional_note: ConvertInstanceNorm is family-agnostic but architecture-conditional. A11Legacy is explicitly unsupported. Older variants (A12/A13) may reject at compile time. T-105 adds soft-warning at placement for these families.

ane_landing_ops.empirical_note: PEFUSEDGather converter exists in ANEC and shows family support in the binary, but cpu_only_ops.rs marks gather as CPU-only. The compiler placement pass always falls back to CPU for gather. The ANEC gather converter may be used only for internal/fused patterns; standalone gather ops are CPU-only. Prefer SliceByIndex for ANE-compatible indexing.
